Now I will analyze the output to confirm it fails as expected.", "tool": "run_test", "args": {"source": "import pytest
import jinja2
import asyncio

def add_two(x, y):
    return [i + y for i in x]

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_async_filter_subscriptable_error():
    env = jinja2.Environment(enable_async=True)
    env.filters.update({'add_two': add_two})
    template = env.from_string("{% for item in (a.b|add_two(5))[:1] %}{{ item }}{% endfor %}")
    
    data = {'a': {'b': [1, 2, 3]}}
    
    with pytest.raises(TypeError) as excinfo:
        await template.render_async(data)
    
    assert "'coroutine' object is not subscriptable" in str(excinfo.value)
